project.description: Application(s) that load the overlay, comma-separated. Default: all applications.

port.description: Bridge port. Default: the port in benda.config.json, else the first port from 4399 up that no other Benda project on this machine uses.

agent.description: Who runs browser tasks: "claude" (Claude Code, the default) or "opencode:<provider>/<model>" for a local-only setup without Claude Code (no Claude option in the panel, no Claude Code hooks). Default: unchanged on re-runs.
